text: 05-02-69 Today I used my free dental treatment under the National Health Security Card for the first time at this clinic. The doctor provided excellent treatment, and the staff were very helpful. The clinic is clean and conveniently located. If you come by car, you can park at the nearby minibus depot across from the clinic. Tell the staff nearby that you're going for dental treatment, and they'll let you park for free. You need to book an appointment with the clinic first. They will then inform you of your appointment date. If you're available, go to the appointment. If not, let them know which date is convenient. Once you have an appointment, you need to use the NHSO and ThaiD apps to reserve your slot. You have 6 hours to use your slot; after that, you need to request a new one. Thank you very much to the doctor for the treatment.
